name: self-improvement-loop
description: Queues OpenClaw sessions for reflection and delivers learned lessons back into the workspace.

sil.description: Path to the sil executable. Overrides sil-config.json.

world.description: sil world that owns these sessions.

stateDir.description: sil state dir, used for the usage event log.

bootstrapFile.description: Workspace file that receives the lesson block. Default AGENTS.md.

sync.description: Write lessons into the workspace at session start. Default true.

reflect.description: Queue a finished session for reflection. Default true.
